items.community: Meydan Horizon, Mohammed Bin Rashid City
items.title: Ellington launches Everly Place in Meydan Horizon
items.summary: Ellington Properties has launched Everly Place, a design-led building of 209 homes in Meydan Horizon, offering one- to three-bedroom apartments plus study units.

items.project: Palm Central Private Residences – next phase
items.title: Nakheel releases new phase of Palm Central Private Residences
items.summary: Nakheel has put a further 222 homes on sale at Palm Central Private Residences on Palm Jebel Ali, spread over three low- to mid-rise buildings with one- to four-bedroom apartments and four- and five-bedroom townhouses.

items.title: Damac releases final tower of Chelsea Residences
items.summary: Damac has opened sales of Tower C, the sixth and last tower of its Chelsea FC-branded waterfront scheme, offering one- to three-bedroom homes from about 827 sq ft and AED 2.56 million.

items.title: Azha Properties launches 800-home Azha Park Residences in Ajman
items.summary: Azha Properties has launched Azha Park Residences in Ajman East: four buildings with 800 homes (196 studios, 404 one-bed and 200 two-bed units) plus 29 shops.
